subject: Interop Summit dinner + partner panel — MDF & booth cross-promo
messages:
From: EdgeWorks Events <events@edgeworks.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Nguyen <claire@edgeworks.com>
Date: 2025-10-12T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Interop Summit — dinner + partner panel idea

Hi Soojin / Marissa / Ben —

Hope you’re all well. EdgeWorks is running a hosted dinner the evening before Interop (Nov 12) for ~60 invited engineering and platform buyers. We’d love Redwood to co-sponsor a 20-minute partner panel during the dinner focused on "real-world inference at scale" and to split a small table in the main expo hall for joint demos the next day.

High-level asks from our side:
- Co-sponsor $6k MDF to cover catering and VIP outreach (we typically split 50/50 with partners)
- One executive + one field demo engineer to attend the dinner & panel (Nov 12)
- Shared tabletop in expo hall (Nov 13) with power and monitor (we cover booth furnishing)

Can you confirm interest and whether Redwood would be able to commit to the MDF + staffing? If yes, I can share venue rules and a draft partner terms PDF.

Quick context: audience is platform/infra buyers from fintech and adtech — good fit for your Dedicated/Private pitch.

Thanks —
Syd Patel
Partnerships Lead, EdgeWorks Alliance
attachments: none

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: EdgeWorks Events <events@edgeworks.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Interop Summit — dinner + partner panel idea

Thanks Syd — this sounds promising. We’re interested in the panel and the shared tabletop. A few quick asks from our side so we can move fast: 

1) MDF confirmation: can you send the formal partner MDF terms (scope, invoicing, cancellation policy)?
2) Audience breakdown: percent buyers vs. practitioners (we typically calibrate talk content based on that).
3) Logistics: can the tabletop be double-width (we’ll bring a small rack/monitor) and is power guaranteed?

Marissa — can you confirm if we have budget capacity to consider a $3k contribution (Redwood share) under our co-marketing line?
Kimberly — can you confirm field staffing availability for Nov 12-13 (one field SE + one TAM)? If not, we should propose a fallback plan (recorded demo + slide handout).

Syd — if you can send the MDF terms and a short venue spec we’ll review and get back with a MAP and draft PO timeline.

Best,
Soojin Lee

Hi all — apologies for the delay. Attached is our partner terms PDF and venue spec. A few clarifications: 

- Venue limits exterior signage on the dinner site (tabletop signage allowed).
- Double-width tabletop is fine but any powered demo rack requires advanced notice (we have a $150 electrical hookup fee).
- Our standard MDF terms: 50/50 split, full refund if cancellation > 30 days, 50% refund if 15-30 days, non-refundable < 15 days. Invoicing: EdgeWorks issues a partner invoice after both sides sign the MAP; we accept PO or credit card for partners.

I attached EdgeWorks_MDF_Terms_v2.pdf and a short venue spec. We can issue a formal invoice/PO once you sign off on the MAP and confirm headcount.

Next steps suggested:
1) Redwood to confirm $3k share and staffing by EOD Oct 21
2) EdgeWorks to issue invoice after MAP signature
3) Redwood finance to process PO by Oct 28 to meet printing deadlines for the VIP list

Thanks — looking forward to partnering.

Best,
Claire Nguyen
Director, Events — EdgeWorks Alliance
